def process_items(items):
    # Convert all items to lowercase to remove duplicates (case-insensitive)
    unique_items = set(item.lower() for item in items)
    
    # Sort the unique items alphabetically
    sorted_items = sorted(unique_items)
    
    # Number each item and print
    for i, item in enumerate(sorted_items, start=1):
        print(f"{i}. {item}")
    
    # Print the total count
    print(f"{i + 1}. Total: {len(sorted_items)}")
